description:

**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1743622
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**SharePoint, OneDrive \& Power Platform Operations/ Engineer**

  



In our globalizing economy the availability of skills and expertise is becoming more and more distributed. Within the Compute Services – SharePoint, OneDrive \& Power Platform Operations and engineering team, we enable EY professionals to meet the increasing pace of business change by delivering productivity and collaboration solutions that empower them to work together where they want and how they want.

  


**EY Technology:**



Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have over 300,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.

  


**EY Technology** supports our technology needs through three business units:


**Client Technology (CT)** \- focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology\-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.


**Enterprise Technology (ET)** – ET supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit\-for\-purpose technology infrastructure at the most affordable possible cost for quality services. ET will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.


**Information Security (Info Sec)** \- Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber\-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

  


**The opportunity**



The SharePoint Operations Engineer is part of a global SharePoint team in a large, complex, and multinational environment. They have expert knowledge in SharePoint (both Cloud and On\-Prem). The individual will be providing Level 3 Operational/Engineering support for areas involving SharePoint Online, with a good understanding of SPO and associated technologies, SharePoint On\-Prem, MS Teams, OneDrive for Business, and other M365 services.

  


**Your key responsibilities**


* In\-depth knowledge of SharePoint, OneDrive and Power platform its features, and related M365 services.
* Experience in installing and configuring SharePoint 2016,2019 \& SE.
* Good troubleshooting skills in both sharepoint on\-prem (2016/SE) along with SPO.
* Advanced experience with Microsoft PowerShell scripting \& automation.
* Intermediate to advanced knowledge of CSOM, MSMQ \& Provider Hosted Apps (PHA).
* Intermediate experience with continuous integration systems.
* Understanding of multiple access and authentication models such as NTLM, Kerberos, Claims\-based, ADFS, SSL, card services, TMG, UAG, etc.
* Knowledge of troubleshooting tools and techniques related to networks and systems i.e. remote access tools, Windows Support tools, connectivity tests, etc.
* Detailed understanding of both Classic and Modern SharePoint functionality including Lists, Document Libraries, Pages, Search, Permissions, and Settings
* In\-depth support knowledge and experience in providing 24/7 support for SharePoint
* In\-depth knowledge in troubleshooting SharePoint end user/client issues.
* In\-depth knowledge in SharePoint permissions, webparts, lists, views and any other site level issues.
* Expert knowledge in Incident management, Service requests, Change requests and ServiceNow processes for SP support.
* In\-depth knowledge on SharePoint support workflow, level 1, level 2 and level 3\. This role is for Level 3 support.
* Capability to help customer to fix the issue and/or create tickets for Microsoft for further troubleshooting.
* In\-depth knowledge on PowerShell scripting and automation experience using scripts.
* Desirable \- Knowledge in deploying SharePoint solutions, updating automation scripts and html pages.
* Desirable – Knowledge of Power Platform products, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI
* Experience with SCRUM/Agile development process is a plus.

  


**Skills and attributes for success**



How your skills and experience will make an impact:

  


**To qualify for the role, you must have**


* History of working credibly within teams and delivering high level of support services on the SharePoint platform
* Proactively anticipates service issues before they occur and able to make recommendations around resolution.
* Proactively monitor outages within a small group or wider group.
* Ability to communicate platform capabilities to customer and provide appropriate recommendations.
* Adapts personal communication style to the style of others, develops rapport and stays calm under pressure or escalating issues using advanced oral and written English communication skills.
* Strong verbal and written skills including strong cross\-cultural communication and the ability to draft effective communications
* Ability to work with people in a variety of cultures, countries and time zones
* Utilizes all aspects of Emotional Intelligence to navigate the interactions and complexities of the business environment and drive leadership performance in oneself and in others.

  


**Ideally, you’ll also have**


* This role does not have a direct supervision responsibility but should proactively own tasks/issues and drive towards resolution independently.
* A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related discipline, or equivalent work experience required
* 2\-5 years of experience in support role with at least last 1 year in SharePoint support.

  


**What we look for**


* Passionate, committed and determined
* Candidate must be flexible to the demands of the services we provide and any project to which they are assigned. The role may require out of office hours work.
* This role is for 24/7 support and requires working in night shift periodically.

  


**What working at EY offers**



We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well\-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:

  


* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

**Network Engineer (WAN) \- GCS**

  


**Senior Associate / Associate**

  


**Job Summary:**



The Network Engineer (WAN) within Global Connectivity Solutions (GCS) supports vulnerability remediation, software lifecycle management, firmware upgrades, and production change execution across enterprise WAN infrastructure. The role performs technical implementation, validation, troubleshooting, and documentation activities involving Cisco routing and switching, Versa SD\-WAN, WAN links, and related connectivity platforms.



The position works with Senior Engineers, Network Engineering, Network Operations, Information Security, Change Management, Outage Management, vendors, carriers, and service providers to execute remediation and upgrade activities safely and maintain compliance with approved software and operational standards.

  


**Job Description**


* Support vulnerability remediation activities across Versa SD\-WAN, Cisco routing and switching, and WAN connectivity platforms.
* Execute approved software and firmware upgrades on Cisco ISR and ASR routers, Catalyst platforms supporting WAN connectivity, Versa SD\-WAN controllers, branch edge devices, and supporting infrastructure.
* Review and implement assigned remediation actions arising from vendor security advisories, software recommendations, defects, and EOS/EOL notices.
* Support software lifecycle management and platform currency for Cisco routing and switching platforms and Versa SD\-WAN infrastructure.
* Perform pre\-upgrade validation, compatibility checks, configuration reviews, software image verification, post\-upgrade validation, and health checks.
* Prepare and maintain implementation procedures, rollback steps, validation plans, technical assessments, change tasks, and deployment records.
* Participate in CAB preparation and support Senior Engineers during technical change reviews when required.
* Execute approved remediation activities, platform upgrades, configuration updates, and network changes within planned maintenance windows.
* Troubleshoot Versa SD\-WAN overlays, underlay connectivity, routing protocols, enterprise routing infrastructure, and WAN link issues.
* Diagnose and resolve issues involving BGP, OSPF, route policies, WAN failover, VPN connectivity, QoS, traffic steering, and application forwarding policies.
* Support troubleshooting of ISP circuits, branch connectivity, SD\-WAN fabric health, cloud connectivity, and data center interconnects.
* Work with vendors, carriers, service providers, and internal teams to restore service and resolve technical issues.
* Participate in outage calls, incident recovery, impact assessment, issue investigation, root cause analysis, and resolution validation.
* Support Problem Management by providing technical analysis, logs, command outputs, trends, and troubleshooting evidence.
* Support remediation waves, upgrade deployments, technology refreshes, and WAN modernization initiatives.
* Participate in testing, implementation, stabilization, and post\-deployment validation activities.
* Maintain operational runbooks, remediation documentation, software compliance records, upgrade history, and implementation outcomes.
* Provide accurate progress updates and promptly escalate technical risks, blockers, failed validations, and dependencies.
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, compliance validation, monitoring, and operational improvement.

  


**Knowledge \& Competencies Required:**


* Working knowledge of Versa SD\-WAN, including Versa Director and Analytics, overlays, underlay connectivity, traffic steering, and branch edge operations.
* Hands\-on knowledge of Cisco routing technologies, including ISR and ASR platforms, and switching platforms supporting WAN connectivity.
* Understanding of BGP, OSPF, IP addressing, route selection, redundancy, VPN services, QoS, and WAN failover.
* Ability to troubleshoot WAN links, ISP circuits, branch connectivity, SD\-WAN fabric health, cloud connectivity, and data center interconnects.
* Experience supporting network firmware upgrades, vulnerability remediation, configuration changes, and lifecycle activities.
* Strong troubleshooting discipline, including collection and interpretation of logs, command outputs, alerts, and monitoring data.
* Working knowledge of Change, Incident, Problem, Risk, and Release Management practices.
* Ability to follow implementation procedures, complete validation accurately, and escalate unexpected conditions appropriately.
* Good technical documentation, communication, collaboration, and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Knowledge of network monitoring, observability, analytics, and automation platforms.
* Basic scripting or automation knowledge using APIs, Python, Ansible, or related tools is desirable.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, compliance focus, and continuous improvement mindset.
* Willingness to work in a global support model, including rotational shifts and support across multiple time zones.
* Flexibility to support maintenance, deployments, upgrades, remediation, and incident recovery outside regular business hours when required.
* Ready to travel when required and collaborate with globally distributed teams, vendors, carriers, and service providers.

  


**Job Requirements:**

  


**Education:**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related technical discipline

  


**Experience:**


* Minimum of 3\-6 years of experience in enterprise WAN network engineering, SD\-WAN, routing and switching, or related network technology support.

  


**Certification Requirements:**


* CCNA preferred. Versa Associate certification and ITIL v4 Foundation are value adds.

**Job Title: Senior Network Engineer (Office Connect) \- GCS**

**Job Summary:**

  



The Senior Network Engineer (Office Connect) within Global Connectivity Solutions (GCS) is responsible for executing vulnerability remediation, lifecycle management, production upgrades, and technical governance activities across campus network technologies. The role provides technical leadership for Cisco Catalyst and Meraki switching and wireless environments, ensuring infrastructure remains secure, current, resilient, and aligned with approved engineering standards.

  



The position plans and leads remediation waves, firmware upgrades, production changes, complex troubleshooting, and service restoration activities. It works closely with Network Engineering, Network Operations, Information Security, Change Management, Outage Management, OSTS, Workplace Technology, Product Owners, vendors, and other stakeholders to deliver upgrades safely and minimize business disruption.

  


**Job Description**

  


* Drive vulnerability remediation activities across Cisco Catalyst switching, Cisco wireless infrastructure, Meraki switching, Meraki wireless, and associated campus network platforms.
* Perform and lead software and firmware upgrades for Cisco Catalyst 9000 Series switches, Cisco Catalyst 9800 Wireless Controllers, Cisco access points, Meraki MS switches, Meraki MR access points, and supporting network infrastructure.
* Review OEM security advisories, software recommendations, field notices, defects, and end\-of\-sale/end\-of\-life announcements, and translate applicable findings into remediation and lifecycle activities.
* Manage software lifecycle and platform currency for Cisco Catalyst, Cisco wireless, and Meraki campus technologies in accordance with approved standards and compliance timelines.
* Plan and execute code upgrades, firmware updates, platform refreshes, configuration remediation, and technology migration activities across global office environments.
* Perform pre\-upgrade assessments, compatibility checks, configuration reviews, image validation, risk analysis, and post\-upgrade health checks.
* Prepare implementation plans, rollback procedures, validation plans, technical assessments, stakeholder communications, and deployment documentation.
* Create and maintain Change Requests, Change Tasks, implementation records, approvals, test evidence, and closure documentation in accordance with established processes.
* Present technical changes during Change Advisory Board reviews and address questions related to impact, risk, dependencies, validation, recovery, and stakeholder readiness.
* Coordinate testing, outage planning, deployment execution, stabilization, and post\-implementation validation with globally distributed technical and business teams.
* Perform advanced troubleshooting of campus LAN, Cisco Catalyst switching, Cisco wireless, Meraki switching, and Meraki wireless environments.
* Troubleshoot Layer 2 and Layer 3 issues involving VLANs, trunking, STP/RSTP/MST, EtherChannel, first\-hop redundancy, routing, access control, segmentation, and policy enforcement.
* Diagnose and resolve wireless issues involving client connectivity, AIRRM, RF Planning, 802\.1X authentication, roaming, RF performance, channel utilization, interference, coverage, capacity, radio optimization, and client experience.
* Apply working knowledge of enterprise Wi\-Fi standards including 802\.11ac, 802\.11ax (Wi\-Fi 6\), and Wi\-Fi 6E during upgrade planning, compatibility assessment, validation, and troubleshooting.
* Use Cisco Catalyst Center Assurance, Software Image Management, Meraki Dashboard, wireless analytics, monitoring tools, logs, and packet captures to identify and resolve service\-impacting issues.
* Lead technical recovery for incidents affecting campus switching, wireless infrastructure, access services, or production upgrade activities, and participate in outage bridges and service restoration efforts.
* Perform root cause analysis, identify corrective and preventive actions, and support Problem Management by analyzing recurring issues and driving permanent technical resolutions.
* Lead assigned remediation waves, switch refreshes, wireless modernization initiatives, access point refreshes, and campus infrastructure upgrades.
* Provide implementation feedback, operational considerations, feasibility inputs, and technical recommendations to Engineering teams for proposed design changes when requested.
* Maintain operational runbooks, implementation procedures, remediation documentation, software compliance records, upgrade history, wireless standards documentation, and deployment outcomes.
* Identify and support opportunities for automation, standardization, compliance validation, pre\-checks, post\-checks, inventory management, monitoring, and reporting.
* Provide technical guidance to Associate and Senior Associate engineers and support consistent execution of campus network remediation and lifecycle activities.

  


**Knowledge \& Competencies Required:**

  


* Strong hands\-on expertise in Cisco Catalyst 9000 Series switching platforms and enterprise Layer 2/Layer 3 campus technologies.
* Experience with Cisco Catalyst 9800 Wireless Controllers, enterprise access points, wireless lifecycle management, and software upgrades.
* Hands\-on knowledge of Meraki MS Switching, Meraki MR Wireless, Meraki Dashboard administration, device onboarding, firmware governance, wireless health, and client analytics.
* Strong understanding of VLANs, trunking, STP/RSTP/MST, EtherChannel/LACP, HSRP/VRRP, ACLs, DHCP Snooping, Dynamic ARP Inspection, port security, and basic campus routing.
* Strong knowledge of wireless fundamentals including RF behavior, channel planning, interference, coverage, capacity, roaming, authentication, and client troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of Wi\-Fi standards, including 802\.11ac, 802\.11ax (Wi\-Fi 6\), and Wi\-Fi 6E.
* Experience with Cisco Catalyst Center (DNA Center), Catalyst Center Assurance, Software Image Management, configuration compliance, inventory, analytics, and troubleshooting capabilities.
* Experience assessing vendor security advisories and delivering vulnerability remediation, firmware lifecycle, and infrastructure modernization activities.
* Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis capability across switching, wireless, authentication, connectivity, and production upgrade issues.
* Working knowledge of ITIL practices, particularly Change, Incident, Problem, Risk, and Release Management.
* Ability to prepare clear implementation plans, rollback procedures, validation plans, technical documentation, and CAB presentations.
* Knowledge of network monitoring, observability, analytics, and automation platforms.
* Experience using APIs, Python, Ansible, or related automation capabilities is desirable.
* Strong communication, stakeholder coordination, vendor management, and influencing skills in a matrixed global environment.
* Risk\-based decision making, strong ownership, attention to detail, and a continuous improvement mindset.
* Willingness to work in a global support model, including rotational shifts and planned activities across multiple time zones.
* Flexibility to support maintenance windows, production deployments, software upgrades, vulnerability remediation, and incident recovery outside regular business hours when required.
* Ready to travel when required to support project, deployment, remediation, or operational activities.

  


**Job Requirements:**

  


* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related technical discipline
* **Experience:** Minimum of 7–10 years of experience in enterprise campus network engineering, switching, wireless, lifecycle management, or related network technology support
